slides.title: What happened
slides.body: Prices are up 3.7% from a year ago. Energy jumped 5.2% in one month and is up 20.4% over the year.

slides.subtitle: CPI, % change from a year earlier

slides.title: Why it matters
slides.body: Higher fuel costs touch almost every budget, and markets now weigh whether the Fed may raise rates.
